user.title: Flame Connect — unofficial
user.description: Community integration, not affiliated with or supported by Glen Dimplex. Wi-Fi cloud fireplaces only. Link through the official Microsoft page; Home Assistant never asks for your password.

data_description.policy: normal: phone/email; social: external identity provider.

link.title: Link your account
link.description: Run the desktop linking assistant described in the [installation guide]({installation_url}). Copy this [official authorization link]({authorize_url}) into the assistant, then paste the captured msal return below. This link expires in 10 minutes.

data_description.callback_url: One-use msal…://auth?code=…&state=… return. Never paste your password.

devices.title: Select fireplaces
devices.description: Only Wi-Fi fireplaces are supported. Temperature values on the wire are Celsius. Automatic follows the device display preference; Home Assistant climate cards follow the installation unit system.

data_description.temperature_unit: auto, C or F; this option does not change the physical device scale.

reauth_confirm.title: Link the same Flame Connect account again
reauth_confirm.description: The stored credentials can no longer be renewed. Link the original account to preserve devices, entities and automations.

reconfigure.title: Refresh fireplace selection
reconfigure.description: Check your connection and try again.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid or expired return. Use the new authorization link and try again.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach Flame Connect. Check the connection and use the new authorization link.
error.invalid_response: The service returned an unexpected response.
error.select_device: Select at least one listed fireplace.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: Link the same account originally configured.
abort.no_devices: No fireplaces were returned by this account.
abort.no_wifi_devices: No compatible Wi-Fi fireplaces were found.

init.title: Flame Connect options
init.description: Changing options reloads the integration and does not send device commands. Experimental entities are created disabled and must be enabled individually.

data.temperature_unit: Preferred temperature unit: auto / C / F

data_description.temperature_unit: Climate cards respect the Home Assistant unit system. No physical scale change.
data_description.experimental_controls: Color, countdown, sound and device scale are not yet physically validated.

invalid_auth.message: Link the Flame Connect account again.

command_failed.message: The command failed or its result could not be confirmed. It has not been retried; read the state before trying again.

invalid_value.message: The selected value is not supported by this fireplace.
